title: The Ordinary Language
author: Jonah Thackeray
blurb: Bram Voss, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud before the house sale closes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
